newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving in a narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving in a narrow range.

text.p: Dhaka shares are expected to move in a narrow range on Sunday as brokers fear a planned agitation by kerb market investors could affect trading.

"The price of the shares may move in a narrow range. The investors will trade cautiously and avoid taking any risk," said broker Sabbir Ahmed. He said there was uncertainty among brokers over the planned agitation outside the stock exchange.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange index closed 28.53 points or 1.21 percent down at 2,241.83 on Saturday.
